d: Russia, India, China are among the founding members of BRICS. However, the trio are also a major power alliance. Russia-India-China or RIC was first envisioned by Moscow in 1990s as an alternative to the United States. Today, RIC is moving forward thanks to BRICS. With more than 6,000 nuclear warheads at their disposal, the RIC is larger, stronger and more powerful than NATO. Meanwhile, India hosts the BRICS Summit in New Delhi, bringing 11 nations together for high-stakes diplomacy, tough negotiations and a unanimous joint declaration. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
